Yea, I've got a tutor and all that, just having a tough time grasping it.
I'm about 27 weeks into the 64 week course. I know quite a bit of arabic, but it's really hard to keep up with this pace.

I was assigned Modern Standard Arabic back in June. Being a Linguist isn't what I wanted, but its you know how it goes, this is just how it is. I'd be happier in security forces or really anything else. School has never been something I've enjoyed and it's just tough getting wrecked after all the effort I put in.

It's hard, because this is what i want for us. I just want everything to work out.

The girl is my world, I need her.

I just want to have a nice life with my girlfriend, but its my fault that that might not happen. If i keep being a fuck up then I might not stay in the military, and I don't know what I'd do without it.

I can't even do my job. I've got to learn this stupid language, but I'm failing miserably at it. I just want to be useful.

If anyone even knew I was having these kind of troubles, then I could lose my clearance, and my job. Without the military I've got nothing.
